summary: SFTP Monitor Enhancement Testing - 19 gap test cases. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests PASSED (100%). Frontend: All 5 tabs verified working (Overview, Transfers, Logs, Speed Metrics, Daily Summary). All SFTP features working in demo mode.

SFTP-03.notes: GET /api/admin/sftp/status returns retry_config with max_retries=3, base_delay=1.0, max_delay=30.0. GET /api/admin/sftp/connection-pool also returns retry_config

SFTP-04.notes: GET /api/admin/sftp/status returns pool stats (max_size=5, available=0, active=0) showing auto-reconnect readiness

SFTP-07.notes: GET /api/admin/sftp/connection-pool returns pool stats with max_size, available, active, total_created, ssl_mode

SFTP-08.notes: GET /api/admin/sftp/connection-pool returns ssl_mode='auto'. Config page has SSL Mode select with auto/strict/reject options

SFTP-09.notes: POST /api/admin/sftp/upload returns status=success with speed_mbps and file_hash. Tested with valid CSV file

SFTP-10.notes: POST /api/admin/sftp/download returns status=success with bytes, speed_mbps, resumed_from fields

SFTP-11.notes: GET /api/admin/sftp/transfer-progress/{id} returns progress with transferred_bytes and total_bytes

SFTP-12.notes: POST /api/admin/sftp/resume/{id} endpoint exists and handles failed transfer resume

SFTP-14.notes: POST /api/admin/sftp/upload with overwrite=false returns overwrite_protected field. Auto-versioning works

SFTP-15.notes: POST /api/admin/sftp/batch-upload returns total, uploaded, failed, malformed, duplicates counts

SFTP-20.notes: POST /api/admin/sftp/upload with malformed CSV returns status=malformed with error and archive_path containing /failed/

SFTP-22.notes: Upload same file twice - second upload returns status=duplicate with file_hash

SFTP-23.notes: Logs include archive_path field showing /archive/processed/ or /archive/failed/ paths

SFTP-25.notes: GET /api/admin/sftp/logs?start_date=2026-03-28&end_date=2026-04-03 returns filtered results. Frontend has date inputs

SFTP-29.notes: GET /api/admin/sftp/error-log/download returns CSV with Content-Type: text/csv

SFTP-16.notes: POST /api/admin/sftp/scheduler/start and /stop work. GET /api/admin/sftp/status returns scheduler.running status

SFTP-30.notes: GET /api/admin/sftp/speed-metrics returns avg_speed_mbps=15.39, max_speed_mbps=25.64, daily_metrics array with 7 days

SFTP-35.notes: GET /api/admin/sftp/daily-summary returns date, total_files, success, failed, malformed, duplicates, success_rate, by_type, store_coverage, top_errors

5_TABS.notes: SFTP Monitor page loads with 5 tabs: Overview, Transfers, Logs, Speed Metrics, Daily Summary

CONNECTION_BANNER.notes: Connection banner shows Pool badge (0/5), SSL badge (auto), Retries badge (3)

OVERVIEW_TAB.notes: KPIs: Total Files (170), Success Rate (92.4%), Records (488.7K), Failed (13), Malformed (3), Duplicates (2), Avg Speed (15.49 MB/s), Total Size (45.56 MB), Stores Today (10/10)

TRANSFERS_TAB.notes: Upload form, Batch upload form, Download form, Processing Pipeline info all present

LOGS_TAB.notes: Date range inputs (start_date, end_date), status filter with malformed/duplicate options, Error Log CSV download button

SPEED_METRICS_TAB.notes: Speed KPIs (Avg, Max, Total Transferred, Total Transfers) and Daily Speed Trend chart

DAILY_SUMMARY_TAB.notes: Summary KPIs, Store Coverage (10/10), Top Errors, By File Type breakdown, Download CSV button

CONFIG_PANEL.notes: SSL Mode select with auto/strict/reject options, Pool Size, Max Retries, Timeout inputs

critical_code_review_comments: All 19 SFTP gap test cases PASS plus 6 additional frontend UI tests
SFTP operations run in DEMO MODE (MOCKED) - no real SFTP server connected
Connection pool with retry backoff (max_retries=3, base_delay=1.0, max_delay=30.0)
SSL/TLS verification modes: auto, strict, reject
File validation: malformed detection, duplicate detection (SHA-256 hash), overwrite protection
Archive paths: /archive/processed/ for success, /archive/failed/ for errors
Speed metrics tracked per transfer with daily aggregation
Daily summary includes store coverage and top errors

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 5 tabs and config panel verified working

seed_data_creation: POST /api/admin/sftp/seed-demo seeds 154 demo records (7 days of SFTP logs). Demo data includes daily_sales, store_inventory, warehouse_inventory files with success/error/malformed/duplicate statuses.
